headline: Ransomware Attack Hits Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd.
body: Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd., a notable player in the automotive components sector, has recently fallen victim to a ransomware attack. The incident forced the company to isolate its servers, leading to temporary disruptions in production and order-processing systems across its facilities. Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. is recognized for its contributions to the automotive manufacturing industry, supplying various critical components. Despite the attack, the company has not disclosed any information regarding potential impacts on its customers or downstream effects.
